Title: Public Preview: Managed Certificate support for Azure API Management

Body.Content:
Managed certificate support for Azure API Management is now in public preview. This enables customers to easily and quickly secure their custom domains with a free certificate provisioned, managed, and automatically renewed by Azure API Management. 

Customers can now effortlessly secure Azure API Management with an SSL certificate, which is provisioned and managed by Azure API Management. This feature is available in all tiers of Azure API Management at no cost. 

Learn more about Azure API Management with an SSL certificate.
